title: docs(readme): correct API references and document missing functions
body: Closes #3. Fixes the inaccuracies the issue called out (and the additional drift the reporter suspected might exist), then documents every previously-undocumented function on the `Mdk` API. ## API corrections - `mdk.acceptWelcome(welcomeJson = welcome.eventJson)` → `mdk.acceptWelcome(welcome)` (same for `declineWelcome`). - `MessageProcessingResult` → `ProcessMessageResult`; the `when` block now reflects the real variants (`ApplicationMessage`, `Proposal`, `PendingProposal`, `ExternalJoinProposal`, `Commit`, `Unprocessable`, `IgnoredProposal`, `PreviouslyFailed`). - Removed the `processMessages` (plural) section — that function does not exist. - `updateGroupMetadata(...)` → `updateGroupData(mlsGroupId, GroupDataUpdate(...))`. - `newMdk(dbPath)` → `newMdk(dbPath, serviceId, dbKeyId, config)` in all three example sites. - `createMessage(...)` examples now pass the required `tags`/`eventTags` parameters (both `null` by default). - `getMessage(eventId)` → `getMessage(mlsGroupId, eventId)`. - `getMessages(mlsGroupId)` and `getPendingWelcomes()` updated to show the required `limit` / `offset` / `sortOrder` parameters. - `MdkUniffiError` → `MdkUniffiException` (subclasses: `Storage`, `Mdk`, `InvalidInput`). - `KeyPackageResult.keyPackage` is **Base64**, not hex; documented `tags` (kind `30443`) vs `tagsLegacy` (kind `443`), plus the previously-undocumented `hashRef` and `dTag` fields. - Data classes corrected: `ByteArray?` instead of `List?` for image fields on `Group` / `Welcome`; added the previously-missing `Message.createdAt`, `Group.lastMessageProcessedAt`, and `Group.selfUpdateState`. ## Newly documented functions The previous README covered a small slice of the public API. The new sections cover every public symbol on the `Mdk` interface and every top-level helper in `src/main/kotlin/build/marmot/mdk/mdk_uniffi.kt`: - **Key packages:** `deleteKeyPackageFromStorage`, `deleteKeyPackageFromStorageByHashRef`; rotation note for `createKeyPackageForEventWithOptions`. - **Group queries:** `getRelays`. - **Group lifecycle:** `leaveGroup`, `selfDemote`, `selfUpdate`, `groupsNeedingSelfUpdate`, `deleteGroup`, `syncGroupMetadataFromMls`, `clearPendingCommit`, `mergePendingCommit`. - **Welcomes:** `processWelcome`, `getWelcome`, `acceptWelcomeJson`, `declineWelcomeJson`. - **Messages:** `getLastMessage`, `deleteMessagesForGroup`, `processMessageWithContext`. - **Encrypted media (messages):** `encryptMediaForUpload`(`WithOptions`), `createMediaImetaTag`, `parseMediaImetaTag`, `decryptMediaFromDownload`. - **Group images:** `prepareGroupImageForUpload`(`WithOptions`), `decryptGroupImage`, `deriveUploadKeypair`. - **Diagnostics:** `groupCapabilityUpgradeStatus`, `upgradeGroupCapabilities`, `groupRequiredProposals`, `groupMemberCapabilities`, `ownLeafIndex`, `groupLeafMap`, `getRatchetTreeInfo`, `pendingAddedMembersPubkeys`, `pendingRemovedMembersPubkeys`, `pendingMemberChanges`. - **Setup:** `initKeyringStore`, `newMdkWithKey`. **Coverage:** 50/50 interface methods and 7/7 top-level helpers are now referenced by name in the README. ## Verification - Every claim cross-checked against the generated bindings in `src/main/kotlin/build/marmot/mdk/mdk_uniffi.kt`. - Prose scanned for AI writing patterns with `shaka scan` — **100/100 PASS**, 0 violations. Diff: +446 / −79 lines on `Readme.md`. @SubatomicPlanets — flagging since you filed the issue. The reporter also noted that "some of these might also be the case in the MDK bindings for other languages." That's a fair guess — the same UniFFI source generates the Swift/Python bindings, so the equivalent READMEs likely need the same audit. --- ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Documentation** * Enhanced MDK Kotlin initialization guidance and keyring priming instructions * Expanded key-package docs covering fields, publish/parse flows, rotation, and deletion from storage * Extended group docs: relays, data updates, lifecycle ops, welcome handling, and sync/merge behaviors * Updated message docs: creation (new optional tags), paginated/sortable retrieval, single-message access, deletion counts, and incoming-processing result variants * Revised data type descriptions and Android integration examples to match updated APIs [![Review Change Stack](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/review-stack-in-coderabbit-ui.svg)](https://app.coderabbit.ai/change-stack/marmot-protocol/mdk-kotlin/pull/6?utm_source=github_walkthrough&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=change_stack)

title: README should be updated
body:
I noticed that the README file is wrong in some places.
- `mdk.acceptWelcome(welcomeJson = welcome.eventJson)` should be `mdk.acceptWelcome(welcome)`. Same with `declineWelcome`.
- `MessageProcessingResult` doesn't exist. Instead, `ProcessMessageResult` exists, but it's quite different.

I just did a quick check, so there may be more issues. Some of these might also be the case in the MDK bindings for other languages.
